user.title: Connect to the label printer app
user.description: Enter where Home Assistant can find the QL Label Printer app.

data_description.url: If the app runs on the same computer as Home Assistant, use http://127.0.0.1:8013. Otherwise, use the address you open the app at in your browser, without a port number.
data_description.password: Only needed if you set a password in the app. Otherwise, leave it blank.
data_description.link_url: The address that opens when you select Visit on the device page. Leave it blank to use the app address. Fill it in if the app address only works for Home Assistant, such as http://127.0.0.1:8013.

reauth_confirm.title: Enter the app's new password
reauth_confirm.description: The label printer app at {url} no longer accepts the saved password. Enter its current password.

error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant can't reach the app at this address. Check the address is right and the app is running.
error.invalid_auth: The password is wrong, or the app needs a password.
error.invalid_url: Enter a full address that starts with http:// or https://.
